description: This Java class `Builtin` contains embedded XML data defining 'built-in' API descriptions for various Java and Android classes, methods, and packages. It appears to serve as a static resource providing API metadata for use by other components in the project.

classes.name: Builtin
classes.description: Contains a static XML string representing built-in API descriptions and a method to access it as a StringReader.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a StringReader over the embedded XML string defining built-in API descriptions.
